description: Grafo stradale del Comune di Parma is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sit.comune.parma.it. These are the roads represented in the form of a graph of the road grid derived from the digitisation of the Regional Technical Charter on a scale of 1:5,000. They are highways, highways, highways, provincial roads, municipal roads and other roads. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Road graph of the Municipality of Parma" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2013-11-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
